title: Joins IBM's San Jose development laboratory
description: Becomes a member of the development laboratory staff at IBM in San Jose, California. [CONFIRM: sequence of Purdue MS, Santa Clara MBA and IBM]

title: Published in Electronics magazine
description: Writes 'Noise simulators help find peril in power-line defects' (Electronics, 7 March 1966), on testing data-processing equipment against power-line disturbances.

title: Returns to India, joins IBM India
description: Returns to India and joins IBM India, where he heads export operations. [CONFIRM: exact title]

title: Pentax Engineering
description: After IBM exits India, he and former colleagues take over the manufacturing facility and set up Pentax Engineering. [CONFIRM: his exact role]

title: Tandon Magnetics
description: Starts Tandon Magnetics in India to manufacture recording heads. Its first export recognition is for 1978-79. [CONFIRM: 1978 or 1979]

title: National Export Award
description: Tandon Magnetics receives a National Award for outstanding export performance from the President of India.

title: Leads the export processing zones movement
description: Serves as chairman of the Federation of Export Processing Zones Associations in India (FEPZAI) and gives the presidential address at its inauguration with the Union Finance Minister. [CONFIRM: year, about 1994]

title: Electronics Man of the Year
description: Receives the ELCINA Electronics Man of the Year Award for 1997-98.

title: Celetronix India Pvt. Ltd.
description: [CONFIRM: founding year, the awards list shows Celetronix as early as 1995-96]

title: Chairman, Tandon Group
description: Leads the Tandon Group of companies. [CONFIRM: current focus, in his words]
